values.2-notes:
I think when in management mode we don't need the expand card that reveals the set and buttons

I think when in management mode the fields for rank and points for honour, glory, status and taint all become editable where the user can just enter a manual number.

And then when saved and back in play mode the boxes go back to being uneditable

The undo works, but it doesn't go away so can be confusing.  Maybe have it so that after hitting the undo the button vanishes after 10-30s this should be plenty of time.  Maybe the undo button can also vanish when the sheet auto saves or a manual save is applied
values.3-notes: I think the Recognition by your lord needs to be moved see the attached screen shots
values.5-notes:
The wounds maths is now correct but I can not check the x3 multiplier etc as the combat section is hidden in management mode

This was a design desicion from previous updates

Maybe combat should be visible in management mode

or maybe the x3 multiplier should be moved somewhere else
